name: Overhead Dumbbell Triceps Extension
summary: A triceps isolation exercise with the arms overhead, which stretches the long head of the triceps.
setup: Sit on a bench with back support or stand tall, holding one dumbbell with both hands.
Press the dumbbell overhead with arms straight, palms under the top plate.
Keep ribs down and core braced, avoiding a big back arch.
Keep upper arms close to the head, pointing up.
execution: Bend the elbows to lower the dumbbell behind the head until you feel a triceps stretch.
Keep the upper arms still and elbows pointing forward.
Extend the elbows to return to the top.
mistakes: Elbows flaring out wide: keep them pointing forward.
Arching the lower back: brace the core and lower the weight.
Going too heavy, causing shoulder or elbow strain: use a controlled load.
Partial range of motion: lower until you feel a stretch.
